confirmedSourceIssue: humanOverview already uses priorityOrder for active/headline selections, but blockerIds and decisionIds are direct registry-order filters. Thus registration order, rather than explicit owner priority, determines the visible blocker ordering.
factsNotToInfer: FLOW-001 current unique owner status at20:03 explicitly says personal entry unavailable and recovery first, yet its priority field remains3. Only that owner should correct priority; renderer must not infer severity from phrases such as stopped, failed or personal.
boundedDesign: Use the existing explicit priority with deterministic ID tie-break for blocker/decision ordering. Keep source current/stale/unknown distinction visible.
Show the highest-ranked current parent delivery and its own availability wording; preserve separately declared child blocker facts and owners without replacing parent priority or status.
Only verified direct parent relationships may group rows, following existing tests; unknown/cyclic/missing relationships remain separate and visible.

Present start/completion and elapsed time compactly using the existing TIMING02 display layer; exact UTC, milliseconds and provenance remain in an accessible detail view. Do not repeat full time/relationship boilerplate in every summary sentence.

Arc source registration is an independent D05 ownership action. Its ACTIVE take must remain visible while source registration is pending; after registration verify owner, worktree, branch, fixed HEAD, review target and current status resolve through the one authoritative worktree.
meaningfulAcceptanceCases: Scramble registry order while keeping explicit priority and task IDs fixed: blocker ordering remains stable and highest explicit priority is first.
Change only labels and blocker wording, including alarming keywords: ordering remains unchanged unless the owner changes priority.
Priority tie and unknown/missing priority remain deterministic; every lower-ranked item stays reachable by expansion.
Parent/child blockers retain both exact texts and owners, while parent facts are never synthesized from child review or progress.
Start/completed UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN; compact timestamps preserve exact source values in details and do not invent elapsed/start from Git mtime.
A claimed task awaiting source registration displays that fact, then switches to matched source once D05 registers it; no second manual progress object is introduced.
coordination: One existing follow-up reference only. UI implementation requires its own worktree/branch and exact scope take after available writer slot; no current App writer is repurposed and no main/other-owner status is changed. Personal service restoration remains highest execution priority.
